```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
source('_theme/theme_quarto.R')
set.seed(887)
df = tibble(
  age = c(18,19,20,33,67,24,37,55,41,31),
  exercise = round(runif(10,0,7)),
  therapy = c(0,0,1,0,1,1,0,0,1,1),
  stress = age*.3 + -.7*exercise + -3*therapy  -.1*age*therapy+ rnorm(10)
)
```
